analysis.title: PayPal Holdings (PYPL): 3Q26 First Take: Beat on lower transaction expenses and higher cost savings
key_insights: PYPL reported a stronger than expected 3Q26 on higher transaction margin and lower opex. Revenue was ~$8.58bn, about -1% vs Visible Alpha consensus of ~$8.71bn.
Transaction margin came in at ~$3.95bn, +2% vs consensus. The beat came mostly from lower transaction expenses, both core and from lower fraud/credit costs.
Non-GAAP operating income was ~$1.61bn, +14% vs street. Non-GAAP opex excluding transaction expense was ~$2.34bn vs street at $2.42bn.
Adjusted EPS was $1.45 ($1.25 GAAP), roughly 11% ahead of consensus. Adjusted net income was ~$1.25bn.
Branded checkout volume grew 1% FXN, below the street at ~2%, but roughly in line with company commentary at the GS conference in September.
The company reduced its opex guidance and raised its cost savings target by year-end.
GS expects the stock to trade mainly around near-term spending commentary in Branded and any commentary on strategic alternatives.
GS looks for three things on the call: QTD spending trends, a cost savings update, and what drove the transaction expense take rate beat.
Other volume buckets: P2P & Other Consumer +10% FXN vs street ~8%, Venmo +14% YoY FXN vs street ~11%, PSP +8% FXN vs street ~10%.
Transaction take rate was 1.58% vs 1.59% GS and consensus. Transaction expense was $4,248mn, 3% below consensus.
4Q26 guidance: slightly positive transaction margin dollars, non-GAAP EPS $1.43 (GAAP $1.37), non-GAAP tax rate ~19-20%. Non-GAAP EPS guide is 6.8% above consensus of $1.34.
FY26 guidance: ~$15.7bn transaction margin dollars, opex growth mid-single-digits, non-GAAP EPS ~$5.60 ($5.07 GAAP) vs consensus $5.37, FCF $6.5bn+, buybacks ~$6bn and capex ~$1bn.
GS keeps a Sell rating and $49 12-month price target (~8x P/E on Q5-Q8 estimates) with the stock at $54.99, implying 10.9% downside.

market_movers.rationale: GS stays Sell after a Q3 beat driven by lower transaction expenses and cost savings. Branded checkout growth slowed to 1% and the price target is based on ~8x P/E on Q5-Q8 estimates.

earnings_insights: PYPL 3Q26 reported 10/27: revenue ~$8.58bn vs Visible Alpha consensus ~$8.71bn (-1%) and GS est $8.715bn.
3Q26 non-GAAP EPS $1.45 reported vs consensus est $1.30 and GS est $1.28. GAAP EPS $1.25 vs consensus est $1.26.
3Q26 transaction margin $3,950mn reported vs consensus est $3,888mn (+2%) and GS est $3,853mn. Transaction margin was 46.0% of revenue.
3Q26 non-GAAP opex $2,337mn reported vs consensus est $2,421mn. Adjusted operating income $1,613mn reported vs consensus est $1,416mn. Adjusted EBITDA $1,831mn vs consensus est $1,672mn.
3Q26 adjusted free cash flow $2,047mn reported vs consensus est $1,676mn (+22%). Diluted shares 858mn, down 11% YoY.
4Q26 guidance: non-GAAP EPS $1.43 (+16% YoY) vs consensus est $1.34, GAAP EPS $1.37 vs consensus est $1.29, transaction profit ~$4,049mn at midpoint vs consensus est $4,035mn.
FY26 guidance: non-GAAP EPS $5.60 vs consensus est $5.37, GAAP EPS $5.07 vs consensus est $5.21, FCF $6.5bn vs consensus est $5.84bn, non-GAAP opex midpoint $9,541mn vs consensus est $9,518mn.
risk_factors: Branded checkout growth slowed to 1% YoY FXN from 5% a year earlier and 2% in 2Q26.
PSP volume growth of 8% FXN missed the street at ~10%.
Revenue and transaction revenue both missed consensus by about 1%.
GS lists upside risks to its Sell view as improving macro, better adoption of new products/services, and an improving competitive environment.
